title: Perfect pelts: reliable 3-star method
body: Inspect the animal first and only hunt a 3-star target. Use the weapon type recommended in the compendium, make a clean vital/head shot, and avoid extra damage. The Buck Antler Trinket can improve the chance of preserving pelt quality after a slightly imperfect kill.

title: Legendary animals
body: Enter the legendary animal territory, look for the on-screen territory notice, then use Eagle Eye to inspect clues. Follow the clue trail until the animal spawns. Pelt quality does not matter on legendary animals, so use enough firepower to finish the hunt safely.

title: Dead Eye basics
body: Dead Eye slows the action and lets you place precise shots. Keep the Dead Eye core filled with food, tonics, sleep, and camp care. Story progression upgrades how marking works, so its controls and capabilities change over time.

title: Health, stamina, and Dead Eye cores
body: The inner core affects how quickly the outer ring regenerates. Eat and rest to maintain cores; use tonics for fast outer-ring recovery. A drained core makes that stat refill much more slowly.

title: Horse bonding faster
body: Ride, feed, brush, calm, and lead your horse. Higher bonding improves handling, health/stamina, whistle range, and unlocks maneuvers. Keep horse reviver in your satchel before long trips.

title: White Arabian encounter
body: A wild White Arabian can be found in the snowy Lake Isabella area after the relevant early story progression. Approach slowly, calm repeatedly, mount when close, and balance through the bucking sequence. Save before attempting if you want an easy retry.

title: Legend of the East satchel path
body: Do Pearson's leather-working upgrades at camp and obtain the required perfect pelts for each satchel. Complete the prerequisite camp upgrade that unlocks Pearson's crafting tools first. The final satchel dramatically increases carrying capacity.

title: Unlock fast travel
body: Upgrade Dutch's lodging in the camp ledger, then upgrade Arthur's lodging. This adds the camp fast-travel map. Additional fast travel options become available from wilderness camps as the game progresses.

title: Raise honor
body: Greet people in towns, help strangers, release caught fish, perform camp chores, donate, and make honorable story choices. Avoid unnecessary civilian violence and robbery when trying to keep honor high.

title: Bounties and wanted status
body: Leave the search area to lose active pursuit. Bounties remain until paid at a post office or resolved by other game events. Masks hide identity from civilians better than from lawmen who get a clear look at you.

title: Treasure map strategy
body: Treasure maps use visual landmarks rather than quest markers. Compare rock formations, rivers, bridges, and distinctive trees. When close, inspect likely cracks, ledges, hollow trees, or stone piles and use Eagle Eye to help spot interactable locations.

title: Gold bars and valuables
body: Gold bars are among the most valuable single items in Story Mode. Explore abandoned locations, treasure chains, and hidden lockboxes, then sell gold and jewelry to a Fence after fences are unlocked.

title: Fence services
body: Fences buy stolen valuables and gold and can craft talismans/trinkets when you have the required materials. They become available through early story progression and specific locations.

title: Keep weapons clean
body: Weapon condition drops with use and exposure. Clean guns with gun oil from the weapon wheel when condition falls. Poor condition reduces performance, especially accuracy and damage.

title: Dual wielding
body: Story progression unlocks an off-hand holster. Once equipped, you can carry and fire two compatible sidearms. Gunsmith equipment can improve belt and holster capacity and degradation resistance.

title: Challenge sets
body: There are multiple themed challenge tracks such as Bandit, Explorer, Gambler, Herbalist, Horseman, Master Hunter, Sharpshooter, Survivalist, and Weapons Expert. Completing ranks unlocks reinforced equipment at the Trapper and contributes toward completion goals.

title: Stranger missions
body: White question-mark encounters can open multi-part side stories. Some are chapter- or time-sensitive, so check the map while moving between main missions if you want broad completion.

title: Use manual saves before experiments
body: Create a manual save before rare horse attempts, expensive purchases, risky robberies, treasure searches, and major crafting runs. Autosave is useful, but manual slots make testing and recovery much easier.

title: Red Dead Online roles
body: Specialist roles organize progression around different activities such as bounty hunting, trading, collecting, moonshining, and naturalist work. Role availability, bonuses, and event payouts can change, so use Live Updates before spending premium currency.

title: Daily routine for steady progress
body: Check daily challenges and current event bonuses, restock ammo/tonics, collect easy nearby objectives, then focus your highest-paying active role or event. Chain activities geographically to reduce travel time.

title: Bounty Hunter tips
body: Bring targets in alive when the mission rewards it, use reinforced lasso when available, and watch mission timing because some bounty payouts depend on completion time. Legendary bounties are repeatable with escalating difficulty.

title: Trader flow
body: Keep Cripps supplied with good carcasses and materials, run resupply missions or buy supplies when efficient, and sell when stock is ready. Local deliveries are safer; distant deliveries trade higher risk for higher payout.

title: Collector efficiency
body: Sell complete collectible sets for better value than individual items when practical. Use the metal detector and shovel for buried items after unlocking them. Spawn cycles and event behavior can change, so verify current routes with live data.

title: Moonshiner basics
body: Reduce mash cost through bootlegger work, choose recipes with buyers when possible, and drive carefully because bottle damage reduces the sale. Complete Moonshiner story content to unlock more of the role.

title: Naturalist choices
body: The Naturalist loop centers on sedating and sampling animals, completing field-guide sets, and legendary animal work. Killing animals can temporarily upset Harriet, so plan hunting and Naturalist sessions separately if you want smooth access.

title: Defensive play style
body: Defensive mode can reduce unsolicited PvP friction in free roam, but it does not make you invulnerable and some activities change your status. Use parley, session switching, and camp safety tools when needed.

title: Posse coordination
body: A persistent posse is useful for repeated group play, shared activities, and coordinated deliveries. Set a waypoint, assign roles before missions, and keep voice/chat communication short during combat or pursuits.

title: Best way to use camera help
body: Aim your phone at the whole TV first so the app can see the HUD, minimap, landmarks, and objective text. Then ask a specific question such as ‘Which way should I go?’ or ‘What mission is this?’ Capture a closer frame if small text matters.

title: Best way to use screen share
body: In the Android build, grant the system screen-capture permission, switch back to the game/remote-play view, then return to the companion when you need help. The app keeps only the latest captured frame unless you explicitly send it with a question.
